/-- Order without maximal elements. Sometimes called cofinal. -/
@[to_dual]
class NoMaxOrder (α : Type*) [LT α] : Prop where
  /-- For each term `a`, there is some strictly greater `b`. -/
  exists_gt (a : α) : ∃ b, a < b
